sections.heading: 1. Consent to Use Lumee
sections.content: Lumee collects your information (symptoms, complaints) so that medical staff can optimally prepare for your treatment. Use is voluntary and your data is securely encrypted.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of Data Processing
sections.content:
Treatment Preparation: Lumee is used to collect information for initial assessment and preparation of your medical care. Your information will be made available digitally to the treating medical staff.

 Optional Use (if activated): Further use of anonymized or pseudonymized data for quality assurance, statistics, or research purposes only occurs if you have given separate consent.

sections.heading: §2 What Data is Processed?
sections.content:
Depending on your information, the following categories in particular are processed:

Health Data: Symptoms, pain intensity, duration of complaints, pre-existing conditions, medications, allergies, and relevant events (e.g., accident history).

Organizational Data: Timestamp of entry, case or process number, waiting area.

Identification Data: Name or date of birth are only collected if this is absolutely necessary for secure assignment to your treatment file.

Note: Please only provide information that is necessary for your current care.

sections.heading: §3 Legal Basis (Art. 9 DSGVO)
sections.content:
Health data is subject to high protection as "special categories of personal data". Processing is based on:

Your express consent (Art. 9 Abs. 2 lit. a DSGVO) through use of the application. The necessity for medical diagnosis and treatment (Art. 9 Abs. 2 lit. h DSGVO) under the responsibility of professional staff.

(Optional) Appropriate safeguards for research/statistics (Art. 9 Abs. 2 lit. j DSGVO).

sections.heading: §4 Voluntary Nature and Revocation
sections.content: The use of Lumee is voluntary. If you decline to use it, you will not experience any disadvantages in treatment or waiting time; data collection will be done personally by staff in this case. You can revoke your consent at any time with effect for the future. The lawfulness of processing carried out until revocation remains unaffected.

sections.heading: §5 Recipients / Data Processing / External AI Services
sections.content:
Data Processing: For technical operation (hosting), we use specialized service providers who are strictly bound to our instructions and secured through data processing agreements (Art. 28 DSGVO).

AI Services: If AI services (e.g., language models) are used to structure data, your data is transmitted in pseudonymized form. The providers are contractually obligated neither to store this data permanently nor to use it for training their own models.

Third Countries: Transfer to countries outside the EU only occurs in compliance with the level of protection required by DSGVO (e.g., through EU standard contractual clauses).

sections.heading: §6 Security Measures
sections.content:
To protect your data, we use state-of-the-art security standards:

End-to-end encryption during transmission (TLS/HTTPS).

Encrypted storage on certified servers.

Strict access control: Only authorized medical personnel have access.

Logging: Every access to sensitive data is logged in an audit-proof manner.

Security by Design: Regular security updates and staff training.

Data minimization and storage only as long as necessary

sections.heading: §7 Storage Period
sections.content: Your data will only be stored for as long as necessary for treatment and legal documentation requirements (according to § 630f BGB, generally 10 years). Afterwards, the data will be deleted or completely anonymized.

sections.heading: §8 Your Rights
sections.content:
You have the right to access, rectification, deletion, restriction of processing, data portability, and the right to object (Art. 15-21 DSGVO).

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 DSGVO).
